metadata.method: Cycle 49's exact MILP (scipy.optimize.milp / HiGHS, imported from src/bml_cycle49.py) re-solved under price and WAR perturbations and on an expanded mixed pool; identical positional quotas (Cycle 26 QUOTAS/POSMAP) and DH rule (any bat) throughout
metadata.base_anchor: base-case re-solve reproduces data/optimizer_comparison_2027.json (OPT-1) exactly at all three budgets — identical 26 player IDs, WAR to 0.05, spend to the dollar — asserted in code before any scenario runs
metadata.price_basis: prior-contract AAV (Spotrac) — a last-price anchor, NOT a predicted 2027 price (same basis and label as Cycles 26/49); scenario prices are uniform or targeted scalings of that anchor
metadata.per_player_max: 15% of the proposed $245.3M cap ($36.795M), applied to the prices in force in each scenario (at x1.2 two anchors cross it — Rendon $35.0M -> $42.0M, Skubal $32.0M -> $38.4M — and are excluded; the count is recorded per scenario)

scenarios.price_x0.8 / price_x1.2: all anchors scaled uniformly; all three budgets; WAR objective unchanged (base Steamer WAR)
scenarios.targeted_bid_up_x1.2: only the 26 players on OPT-1's proven-optimal floor roster scaled x1.2; floor budget only
scenarios.war_haircut_33plus: Steamer WAR x0.85 for players aged 33+ (FA-class ages; 93 of 199 pool players), base prices; each roster also re-scored on unhaircut WAR
scenarios.mixed_prearb_fa_floor: FA pool + pre-arb pool at the floor budget only

prearb_pool.definition: data/salaries_2026.json rows with Spotrac status exactly 'Pre-Arbitration' and a committed player_id, not in the 2027 FA class, with a Steamer 2027 WAR (fg_steamer_2027_bat/pit by ID), position from the same file via Cycle 26 POSMAP
prearb_pool.price_label: $1.0M is the repo's pre-arb PLACEHOLDER convention (Spotrac lists every such player at a flat $1,000,000; Cycles 41/46 document the placeholder rows) — it is NOT a measured salary
prearb_pool.framing: a real club cannot sign another club's pre-arb players; this solve answers what the floor buys a club that develops or holds pre-arb talent — the floor is survivable with internal pre-arb production. NOT a shopping list
